_about: Public-domain John Brown of Edinburgh (1784-1858, United Presbyterian minister and professor of exegetical theology; grandson of John Brown of Haddington, whose shelf is separate) for the Word Hoard: Discourses and Sayings of Our Lord (New York: Carter, 1854, 2 vols), the Analytical Exposition of Romans (Carter, 1857) and Expository Discourses on First Peter (Carter, catalogued 1855), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

jbrowne-discourses-sayings-1: Discourses and Sayings of Our Lord Jesus Christ, vol. 1 (New York: Robert Carter, 1854)
jbrowne-discourses-sayings-2: Discourses and Sayings of Our Lord Jesus Christ, vol. 2 (New York: Robert Carter, 1854)
jbrowne-romans-1857: Analytical Exposition of the Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Romans (New York: Robert Carter, 1857)
jbrowne-first-peter: Expository Discourses on the First Epistle of the Apostle Peter (New York: Carter; catalogued 1855, the OCR shows 1849 near the title)

_alternates.jbrowne-first-peter: the 1848 Edinburgh printing (Google scans, two volumes); the 1956-58 reprints on IA are avoided
